# `crc32`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
crc32(expr)
```

Returns a cyclic redundancy check value of the `expr` as a bigint.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `hash_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT crc32('Spark');
```

Result:

```text
1557323817
```
